== Summary ==
Slip “•Ben Solo” cut unchanged from page 2 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF file created 2 February 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (590, 222, 1102, 945)). Version [[Ben Solo]] (Original). Not a recreation.
